nodes.description: CardMintingFacilitator.owner fixed privileged address used in all require(msg.sender==owner) guards
CardConfig schema reference; swappable by owner via upgradeCardConfig
EtherGenCore storageContract reference; swappable by owner via updateStorageContract
claimedAddresses mapping gating one free card per address
newUserBonusCardTradable flag marking bonus cards untradable
referals array holding unpaid referer/referee address pairs
EtherGenCore.totalCardSupply monotonically incremented on every mint, doubles as cardId
cardIdMapping: authoritative card ownership and attribute storage
privilegedMintingModules whitelist checked in mintCard
privilegedTransferModules whitelist used for ERC721 transfers and referal unlocking
paused circuit breaker gating mint/transfer/listing operations
MappedMarketplace.listings mapping of cardId to Listing struct with prices
listedCardIds array used for market enumeration and swap-remove
whitelistedContracts mapping allowing contract sellers to list
MappedMarketplace.owner controlling withdrawals, pause and configuration
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used in access checks, seeds and refunds
block.timestamp (now): miner-influenced clock used for RNG seed and marketplace pricing/expiry
generateRandomCard derives card attributes from a uint32 seed built from blockhash and caller data
generateRandomMonster builds monster attributes and accumulates uint24 totalCost
generateRandomSpell builds spell abilities and accumulates uint24 totalCost
upgradeCardConfig owner-only swap of the external CardConfig schema
updateOwner owner-only change of CardMintingFacilitator owner
claimFreeFirstCard mints one free card per address and enqueues a referal bonus
allocateReferalBonus pushes referer and referee addresses onto the referals array
awardReferalBonus permissionless payout that pops the referals queue and mints a card
setNewUserBonusCardTradable owner-only toggle of bonus card tradability
mintCard privileged module entry point that stores a Card and increments totalCardSupply
transfer ERC721 transfer with ownership, tradability, verifier and pause checks
transferFrom ERC721 approved transfer path invoked cross-contract by the marketplace
approve registers cardIdApproveds for ERC721 transfers
removeCardOwner swap-removes a card from the owner collection and clears ownership
assignCardOwner writes owner and collection pointer for a card
isCardTradeable gate based on referalCardsUnlocked and isReferalReward
unlockUntradeableCards privileged transfer module unlocks referal cards for a player
manageApprovedTransferModule owner-only transfer module whitelist update
manageApprovedMintingModule owner-only minting module whitelist update
setPaused owner-only toggling of the paused circuit breaker
listCard writes a Listing priced in a time-decaying curve and pushes cardId
purchaseCard payable purchase: pays seller, refunds excess then transfers the card
removeListing owner-of-card or timeout based delisting
getCurrentPrice linear price interpolation over secondsSinceListing
withdrawBalance owner-only drain of the marketplace balance
updateOwner owner-only change of MappedMarketplace owner
updateStorageContract owner-only swap of the EtherGenCore address
whitelistContract owner-only approval of contract sellers
isWhitelisted uses extcodesize to decide if a seller must be whitelisted
external call storageContract.mintCard(recipient,newCard) executed after local state updates
external call seller.transfer(sellerProceeds) paying an untrusted address
external call msg.sender.transfer(bidExcess) refunding caller-controlled address
external call owner.transfer(this.balance) sends whole contract balance
external call storageContract.transferFrom(seller,msg.sender,cardId) reaching EtherGenCore state
external constant calls into the swappable CardConfig contract for costs and attributes
inline assembly extcodesize(seller) used for contract detection
randomSeed uint32 parameter rehashed on every generation step
cardDetails uint8[14] parameter mutated in place by monster/spell generators
referer address parameter of allocateReferalBonus
recipient address parameter of mintCard
cardId parameter used by transfer/approve/ownerOf paths
newOwner address parameter of transfer/updateOwner/assignCardOwner
startPrice uint128 parameter of listCard
totalCost uint24 accumulator of card attribute costs
newMutation/newAbility uint8 value returned by schema getters
numMutations uint8 derived from randomSeed % 12 then clamped
cardDetails memory array created in generateRandomCard
price uint256 computed from the listing price curve
seller address resolved from storageContract.ownerOf
bidExcess uint256 = msg.value - price refunded to buyer

edges.reason: msg.sender determines which address may claim the free card, guarded by claimedAddresses
msg.sender cast to uint32 is passed as the card RNG seed, making the outcome caller-predictable
block.timestamp (now) is multiplied into the seed used to generate the referal card
block.timestamp is recorded as listTime, the anchor for the price curve and expiry
purchase price depends on now - listTime, miner-manipulable within the block
listing removal timeout compares now - listTime against removalDuration
price interpolation uses secondsSinceListing derived from block.timestamp
caller must be present in privilegedMintingModules to mint cards
caller must be the recorded card owner to transfer
caller must be an approved transferer or privileged transfer module
caller must own the card to register an approval

require(msg.sender == owner) protects the tradability toggle

normalization_plan.reason: Internal helper seed parameter has no independent security meaning outside the card generation routine
Mutable card attribute array parameter only carries meaning inside the monster attribute builder
Referer address parameter is only consumed when enqueuing the referal bonus
Recipient address is the storage write target of the mint operation
Card identifier parameter scopes the ownership and approval checks of the transfer path
New owner address parameter is written into card ownership by the assignment helper
Starting price parameter only feeds the on-chain listing price curve
uint24 cost accumulator drives the arithmetic-sensitive attribute budget checks
Schema-returned mutation value is immediately written into card attributes
Clamped mutation count controls the loop bound of the cost accumulation
Memory array is the output buffer of the card generation function
Computed sale price controls seller payout, marketplace cut and refund arithmetic
Resolved seller address is the target of the external value transfer
Excess value calculation feeds the refund external call to the buyer
